# convert_to_pdf_tool

> Convert an existing Office document (PowerPoint .pptx, Word .docx, Excel .xlsx, or their .ppt/.doc/.xls/ODF cousins) that is already stored as an LlmFile int...

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `data` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations (default); grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=convert_to_pdf_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Convert an existing Office document (PowerPoint .pptx, Word .docx, Excel .xlsx,
or their .ppt/.doc/.xls/ODF cousins) that is already stored as an LlmFile into a
PDF. Pass the `llm_file_id` of the source file. The PDF is persisted as a new
LlmFile and AUTOMATICALLY ATTACHED to the tool-result message; always include the
returned markdown link when referencing it.

Use this to turn a generated/attached deck or document into a shareable PDF. To
create a PDF from Markdown text (a report/brief/letter), use `run_python_skill`
with `script_id: "pdf_from_markdown"` instead — do NOT use this tool for that.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `llm_file_id` | integer | yes | Id of the source LlmFile (an Office document) to convert to PDF. |
| `directory_path` | string | no | Optional virtual folder for the result (e.g. "/decks/2026"). Defaults to "/skills/pdf". Regenerating is safe — a same-named file is auto-versioned ("Title (2)"), never overwritten. |
